description.en:
Basic Attack

Yangyang performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Yangyang consumes STA to lunge forward, dealing Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack: Zephyr Song

Use Basic Attack after Heavy Attack or Dodge Counter to perform Heavy Attack Zephyr Song, dealing Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Yangyang consumes STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to thrust forward, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Yangyang melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Yangyang mengonsumsi STA untuk menerjang ke depan, memberikan Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack: Zephyr Song

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Heavy Attack atau Dodge Counter untuk melakukan Heavy Attack Zephyr Song, memberikan Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Yangyang mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dari udara, memberikan Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menusuk ke depan, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en: Yangyang wields her sword to create a whirling vortex of winds that pulls nearby enemies to the center, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id: Yangyang mengayunkan pedangnya untuk menciptakan pusaran angin berputar yang menarik musuh di sekitar ke tengah, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en: Yangyang conjures a mighty Cyclone that pulls nearby enemies, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id: Yangyang memanggil Cyclone dahsyat yang menarik musuh di sekitar, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en: Yangyang recovers 30 STA after she casts a Mid-air Attack Feather Release.
description.id: Yangyang memulihkan 30 STA setelah melancarkan Mid-air Attack Feather Release.

description.en: Yangyang's Aero DMG Bonus is increased by 8% for 8s after casting Intro Skill Cerulean Song.
description.id: Aero DMG Bonus Yangyang meningkat sebesar 8% selama 8 dtk setelah melancarkan Intro Skill Cerulean Song.

description.en: Yangyang sends the target into the air, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id: Yangyang melontarkan target ke udara, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
Heavy Attack: Stormy Strike

When Yangyang has 3 Melodies, she can cast Stormy Strike after Heavy Attack or Dodge Counter, dealing Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack: Feather Release

When Yangyang has 3 Melodies, cast Basic Attack in mid-air to consume all Melodies and perform consecutive strikes, diving from mid-air, dealing Aero DMG. As Yangyang lands, she sheathes her sword with an attack, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.

Melody

Yangyang can hold up to 3 Melodies
Yangyang obtains 1 Melody with every Basic Attack 4 on hit.
Yangyang obtains 1 Melody for every Heavy Attack Zephyr Song on hit.
Yangyang obtains 1 Melody for every Resonance Skill Zephyr Domain on hit.
Yangyang obtains 1 Melody upon casting Intro Skill Cerulean Song.
description.id:
Heavy Attack: Stormy Strike

Saat Yangyang memiliki 3 Melody, ia dapat melancarkan Stormy Strike setelah Heavy Attack atau Dodge Counter, memberikan Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack: Feather Release

Saat Yangyang memiliki 3 Melody, lancarkan Basic Attack di udara untuk mengonsumsi seluruh Melody dan melakukan serangan beruntun, menukik dari udara, memberikan Aero DMG. Saat mendarat, Yangyang menyarungkan pedangnya dengan sebuah serangan yang memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Melody

Yangyang dapat menyimpan hingga 3 Melody
Yangyang mendapat 1 Melody setiap Basic Attack 4 yang mengenai target.
Yangyang mendapat 1 Melody setiap Heavy Attack Zephyr Song yang mengenai target.
Yangyang mendapat 1 Melody setiap Resonance Skill Zephyr Domain yang mengenai target.
Yangyang mendapat 1 Melody saat melancarkan Intro Skill Cerulean Song.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Restore 4 Resonance Energy per second for 5s for the incoming Resonator.
description.id: Memulihkan 4 Resonance Energy per detik selama 5 dtk untuk Resonator yang masuk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Intro Skill Cerulean Song increases Yangyang's Aero DMG Bonus by an additional 15% for 8s.
description.id: Intro Skill Cerulean Song meningkatkan Aero DMG Bonus Yangyang sebesar tambahan 15% selama 8 dtk.

description.en: Heavy Attack recovers an additional 10 Resonance Energy for Yangyang when it hits a target, which can be triggered 1 time every 20s.
description.id: Heavy Attack memulihkan tambahan 10 Resonance Energy untuk Yangyang saat mengenai target, yang dapat aktif 1 kali setiap 20 dtk.

description.en: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 40%. The Wind Field's pulling effect on surrounding targets is enhanced, and the pulling range is expanded by 33%.
description.id: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus meningkat sebesar 40%. Efek tarikan Wind Field pada target di sekitar diperkuat, dan jangkauan tarikan diperluas sebesar 33%.

description.id: Damage Mid-air Attack Feather Release meningkat sebesar 95%.

description.en: Resonance Liberation Wind Spirals's damage is increased by 85%.
description.id: Damage Resonance Liberation Wind Spirals meningkat sebesar 85%.

sequences.name: A Tribute to Life's Sweet Hymn

description.en: After casting Mid-air Attack Feather Release, the ATK of all team members is increased by 20% for 20s.
description.id: Setelah melancarkan Mid-air Attack Feather Release, ATK seluruh anggota tim meningkat sebesar 20% selama 20 dtk.
